cost_of_equity._doc: Owner-set cost of equity by profile and market, CAPM-built. The value is the midpoint of the owner's application range; the range is a flag band, never a clamp. Keyed by the market of the cash flows because the risk-free rate must match their denomination.

regime_deviations._doc: Owner-recorded structural regime deviations. A regime changes no valuation: it puts a note on each member's run and separates the members in a wave scorecard, so a deliberate through-cycle stance is not mistaken for a defect or counted once per name.

unrated._doc: When a valuation is withheld instead of published (owner, 2026-09-21: pre-revenue names 'urgently require an explicit Unrated / Pre-Revenue state rather than outputting distorted fractional-weight numbers like $3.90'). An unrated name publishes no intrinsic value, no 12-month target and no rating; the figure the engine computed is kept as `indicative_iv` for audit only.
unrated.min_weight_rationale: Below about a third of the profile's intended weight the published number is one or two side legs standing in for a method set that could not be computed: NuScale priced at $3.90 on 0.20 of its weight, from a forward-revenue multiple alone. Bloom (0.65, anchor dropped) stays rated and says so.

fcf_guidance_fade._doc: Owner, 2026-09-22. How an ACCEPTED free-cash-flow guidance overlay enters a DCF: never held flat. A guided 25% margin is inflated by advance billings and reservation prepayments -- cash borrowed from the future -- and neutralises once delivery catches up with order velocity. Years 1-3 take the guidance; years 4-7 fade it; years 8-10 and the terminal sit on a floor the installed-base service revenue supports (about 20% adjusted EBITDA x 70-80% conversion).

guidance_channel._doc: PROPOSED 2026-10-03 (owner asked for the channel; the numbers are the builder's and await the owner's review). How the research's guidance-derived estimates (section 2G -> guidance_estimates extractor) enter a DCF: years 1..explicit_years take the scenario's recommended revenue growth (FY+1, then FY+2 when the research gives one, else FY+1 again); the next fade_years fade linearly onto the engine's own growth path (its convergence/decay schedule or flat g); every later year and the terminal are the engine's. Guidance never sets the baseline or the terminal (owner rule 2026-09-20). Derivation: management guides one year, sometimes two (explicit_years 2, the shorter of the fcf_guidance_fade precedent's 3); a 3-year fade lands on the engine path by year 5, inside the 10-year projection's first half, mirroring fcf_guidance_fade's explicit+fade = 7 scaled to the 2-year horizon. min_confidence: a LOW-confidence estimate (no guidance, thin consensus) is shown but not channelled.

ppa_project_finance._doc: PROPOSED 2026-10-03 (the owner set the methodology -- P50 generation with degradation, a contracted PPA window then a capture-adjusted merchant tail, opex and maintenance reserves, tax credits, bifurcated discounting and FCFE through sculpted non-recourse debt; the numbers here are the builder's and await the owner's review). degradation_by_technology: solar 0.5%/yr is the module-warranty standard the owner cited; wind 0.2%, hydro nil, storage 2% (cycling). asset_life_by_technology: solar 30, wind 25, hydro 60, storage 15 years. capture_rate 0.85: solar and wind realise 80-90% of the average wholesale price in liquid markets (profile risk). merchant_wacc_premium 150bp over the contracted WACC: the profile table carries IPP 6.0% vs Merchant Power 6.5% (50bp) for a near-term merchant book; a tail 15+ years out carries price-formation and curtailment risk on top. maint_capex_pct_revenue 6%: inverter and gearbox reserves plus repowering provisions on yieldco disclosures run 4-8% of revenue. opex_pct_revenue_default 30% and da_pct_revenue_default 35% apply only when the statements give no EBITDA or D&A. equity_spread 150bp reuses ddm_equity_spread (the cost of equity over WACC where no CoE row exists). scenario: bear takes P75-like generation (-5%) and merchant prices -20%, bull merchant +15%.

guidance_forecast._doc: PROPOSED 2026-10-03 (the owner set the five principles; the numbers are the builder's and await review). The guidance-to-forecast engine (src/agents/analysis/guidance_forecast.py): fade_years 4 (the 3-5 year window the principle names, mid); max_horizon_years 6 (a medium-term target further out than FY+6 is capped there); organic_spread_flag 500bp over market growth (the principle's threshold); cash_conversion_bounds 60-120% of net income (the principle's); capex_alpha and nwc_intensity are medians of the audited history, bounded; da_useful_life_years 10 for the PP&E roll-forward; tax from history bounded 10-35% else 21%; terminal ROIC at least WACC + 200bp so the reinvestment identity (g / ROIC) is defined; jaws_margin_step 50bp. Curves: I regulatory lag = logistic S-curve, year 1 capped at 15% of the gap (the lag); II operating leverage = convex (t/T)^2 (J-curve); III retail rollout = linear with a quarter of one year's step as year-1 pre-opening drag; IV platform = linear (the deliberate path to breakeven).

target_margins._doc: Owner rule 1 (2026-09-23): the unprofitability fallback for the projection family. A name the OE<=0 gate flags keeps its DCF weight through `Rev DCF (Target Margin)`: revenue projected on the run's growth path, the EBIT margin ramped linearly from today's to a terminal margin benchmarked to mature defence/aerospace peers, taxed, discounted at the firm's cost of capital. No reinvestment charge (the engine's charge is observation-only everywhere) and no EV/Backlog: backlog conversion differs too much between a prime subcontractor and a launch manufacturer for one constant.

regime_flags._doc: Computed, not owner-recorded (contrast regime_deviations). bridge_adjustments.note: Owner, 2026-10-04 (Visa review): per-company equity-bridge items, filing currency. debt_like is added to net debt; shares_as_converted replaces the share count (preferred_in_shares: the convertible preferreds are inside it, so their book value is not deducted); one_off_opex {fiscal year: amount} is added back to core EBITDA/EBIT/net income. Only ACCEPTED entries price. minority_interest (owner, 2026-10-07) replaces the feed's minority interest.

V.basis: Shares: class A 1,702m + B-1 3m + B-2 1m + B-3 91m + C 73m + series A/B/C preferred 10m class A equivalents = 1,880m as-converted (10-Q Q3 FY26 stockholders' equity note); diluted weighted average 1,898m (Q3 FY26) for reference. Debt-like: the uncovered accrued litigation ~$363m (accrued $1,274m less U.S. covered $822m, which the $888m restricted escrow funds, and VE-covered $89m, recovered from series B/C). One-off: FY2025 U.S. covered litigation provision $2,210m (non-GAAP special item $2,533m; the ~$300-350m uncovered provision recurs and stays in costs).
V.source: Visa 10-Q for the quarter ended 2026-06-30 and FY2025 10-K; Q3 FY26 and Q4 FY25 earnings releases

BLK.basis: CIPs deconsolidated and own investments kept, against the feed (FMP: debt 14,968 incl. leases 2,224; cash 10,492; short-term investments 15,144 all counted as cash; minorities 6,927). debt_like 15,883 = contingent consideration 7,875 (GIP/HPS deferred and earn-out units at fair value) + CIP cash 335 + CIP investments 10,525 - BlackRock's net interest in CIPs 2,913 + deferred-comp hedges 61 (offset a compensation liability). Result: net debt ~2,991 = notes 12,744 + contingent 7,875 - own cash 10,157 - own investments 7,471 (equity-method stakes, seed net of hedges, carried interest -- not haircut). minority_interest 99 = NCI 6,927 - CIP NCI 4,000 - Subco units 2,828 (7.6m Class B-2 units, exchangeable 1:1, in diluted shares). Shares: Q2 2026 diluted weighted 164.6m incl. Subco units. One-off 2025: acquisition-related compensation 738 + transaction costs 122; amortisation 775 and the contingent-consideration mark +720 sit below EBITDA. Contingent consideration is debt-like, not extra shares (not both).
BLK.source: BlackRock 10-Q for the quarter ended 2026-06-30 (balance sheet; notes on investments, consolidated sponsored investment products, borrowings); 2Q26 and 4Q25 earnings releases (as-adjusted reconciliations)
